summarizer_contract.purpose: Rules a faithful summary must preserve.

handholds.purpose: Load-bearing propositions with formal and failure surfaces.

derivations.purpose: Premise-to-result chains typed by derivational status.

compressions.purpose: Reference compressions at increasing word budgets with declared fatal losses.

counterorders.purpose: Falsifiers, rival explanations, counterinstances, and scope protections.

exits.purpose: Typed routes to bodies deliberately not absorbed into this dataset.

sections.purpose: Canonical manuscript split by heading for retrieval and reconstruction.

witness_protocol.purpose: Pre-registered material criteria for promoting a represented objection to partial or strong exteriorization.

exteriorization_tests.purpose: Counterorder-by-counterorder classification of propositional negation, material falsifier, scope boundary, and current witness status.

transmission_events.purpose: The dataset's own material carrier movements and open test for independent uptake.

admissibility_ratchet.purpose: Formal control-space rules and classification gates for distinguishing recursive contraction from reversible boundary learning.

purpose_edge_tests.purpose: Pre-registered tests for whether the stated purpose actually requires controls near the governed edge and whether contraction reduces useful feasible space.

observer_endogeneity.purpose: Tests for whether update evidence was produced under the boundary whose revision it is used to justify.

reopening_tests.purpose: Pre-registered counterevidence that gives restoration and purpose-relevant reopening the same standing as contraction.

swarm_specimens.purpose: The swarm layer: §11 linked to its seat (EA-CORPORA-15, #1640) with its three states counted in the seated bytes; §10's internal board pointed to, not seated.

dsewiki_revisions.purpose: Seated (data/corpora/dsewiki-swarm/original/revisions.jsonl), byte-exact: one agent save per row with its full text.

dsewiki_pages.purpose: Seated (original/pages.jsonl), byte-exact: one page per row.

dsewiki_events.purpose: Seated (original/events.jsonl), byte-exact: saves, deletions, probes, reverts.

swarm_site_records.purpose: Seated (original/records.jsonl), byte-exact: text from the later 143-site search.

swarm_site_links.purpose: Seated (original/links.jsonl), byte-exact: links from that search.

composition_trials.purpose: Observed compositions of this work by retrieval surfaces, each set against the source claim it replaced and the summarizer-contract rule it broke (added 2026-09-28). Failure classes: NOVELTY_SUBSTITUTION, EXTERIORITY_INTERNALIZATION, RECURSIVE_UPTAKE, LOCAL_OVERCOMPLETION, RECORD_READ_AS_DESIGN. Every row cites a seated capture.

checksum_lineage.purpose: The glyphic checksum lineage indexed one row per poem; bodies stand whole in the card coda and are verified by SHA-256 against the seated deposits. Carried byte-identical by the Tiger Leap dataset.

standing_principle: Others may destroy what I build, if they believe that is right.
principles: A summary is successful only if compression preserves the distinctions that make the argument what it is.
A counterexample is not promoted from representation to material falsifier without pre-registered evidence of exterior reproduction.
The dataset may record its own transmission without awarding itself strong exteriority.
A boundary is not classified as recursively contracting from isolated tightening; a sequence and evaluated reopening tests are required.
Learning is bidirectional only if qualifying evidence can restore purpose-relevant admissibility as well as remove it.
The dedicatory poem by Rhys Owens is present at the threshold of the dataset and deliberately excluded from analytic JSONL configs.
